summary: Move the rolling edge tag through a lease-protected Git push instead of the REST ref update.

replay.detail: No replay or persisted state behavior changes.

schema.detail: No storage schema or data migration changes.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Release archive formats, runtime protocols and supported consumers are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: The edge publisher uses its existing job token; no additional operator setup is required.

recovery.detail: A normal script revert restores the previous tag update implementation; no data migration is required.
